heading: Responsible source
lead: In this subtitle, the term “responsible source” means a prospective contractor that—

tree.text: has adequate financial resources to perform the contract or the ability to obtain those resources;
is able to comply with the required or proposed delivery or performance schedule, taking into consideration all existing commercial and Government business commitments;
has a satisfactory record of integrity and business ethics;
has the necessary organization, experience, accounting and operational controls, and technical skills, or the ability to obtain the organization, experience, controls, and skills;
has the necessary production, construction, and technical equipment and facilities, or the ability to obtain the equipment and facilities; and
is otherwise qualified and eligible to receive an award under applicable laws and regulations.
